rough_upload.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: deliberately poor organizer-submitted event photograph used behind a full-screen mobile event detail at 390×844 with object-fit: cover.
Primary request: Generate one portrait phone snapshot of a casual adult block-printmaking workshop in a modest local community studio. Make the technical defects painfully obvious, like an organizer hurriedly uploaded the first bad photo from an old phone, not like an artist intentionally making a beautiful image.
Scene: dull cluttered worktable with ink roller, block-print scraps, plain cups, cutting mats and ink stains; fragments of adult arms and hands near the table edges only. Much too much boring blank off-white wall and ceiling above the table. Crooked camera angle and careless framing. No identifiable faces.
Technical appearance: harsh direct on-camera phone flash blows out a patch of the wall and nearest objects; ugly greenish mixed indoor light; muddy noisy shadows; genuinely poor focus and smeared motion blur from a shaky camera; compression artifacts. Important: defects must be obvious in the TOP HALF because the lower half will receive a dark interface scrim. Cropped hands may be at the bottom edges. Ordinary banal surroundings, unflattering lighting, no beautiful subject isolation.
Portrait orientation, 1024×1536 if possible. No text, letters, logos, watermarks, borders, or UI.
Avoid cinematic lighting, polished editorial photography, retro aesthetic, intentional attractive film grain, dramatic storytelling, a carefully staged composition, perfect sharp detail or glossy studio imagery. This should look authentically technically bad while still visibly being a local printmaking workshop.
